sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 20 (quality number 19), Internal Quality Checks row 20, Deterministic Checks check-solve-contract.py; workbook sheets read via openpyxl including annotations
evidence: Frozen solution/solve.sh:1-6,37-38 has a Bash shebang, LF bytes, copies its own static app to /app, and only resets /app/app.db plus WAL/SHM after checking no process has them open; it does not write /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution, use pkill, or set NODE_ENV=production. Frozen solution/app/server.js:7-8 resolves assets relative to __dirname and selects DB_PATH before its own default app.db; :130-131 serves shipped public assets; :142-169 listens on 0.0.0.0 with default port 3000, creates SQLite schema with IF NOT EXISTS and backfills revision snapshots with INSERT OR IGNORE. Empty supplied seed requires no inserted starter snippets. Focused actual run in the built frozen agent image sha256:0e603f6d29172b578e12a584b022cd55e2acbb0bd7755bf7270ec8db7d5ff07d: evidence/row19-runtime-probe.log SHA256 f20452fe5b990c4687c760c89bbb3c5a61a946a1f92b2173d46eb99ff17ea2d8 records command/source hashes, bash -n exit 0, two successful installer runs and exact installed server hash. Sanitized env -i, UID/GID 65534, cwd /tmp, node /app/server.js on port 3000 produced health and root 200 and both built assets 200; default DB retained a successful authored record across a new process. An independent /tmp/row19-custom.db began empty, accepted a save and update, and retained exact code plus revisions [2,1] across two fresh processes launched from /tmp/row19-app-copy/server.js. Result reports all 13 contract assertions true, docker exit 0 (4.047 seconds). Existing Golden browser/persistence/build/dependency artifacts all match their raw-index SHA256 values; browser logs separately show rendering, execution, successful save/readback and history across replacement. Adversarial analysis: an app that hardcodes /app/app.db can pass a default-path smoke but fails the custom-DB empty-state and alternate-copy readback probes; this reference passed both. A conforming frontend bundled at solve time, or permitted public-network installation, must not fail just because package.json includes build dependencies absent from the runtime image; the runtime entry only requires preinstalled Express/better-sqlite3 and shipped frontend bytes. Current public-network workbook/profile overrides the older no-network Internal Quality Checks wording. This is row-19 runtime evidence only, not a private deterministic checker invocation, complete configured judge run, cold-build timing, Oracle/target-model score or portal QC result; those other measurements are not claimed.
